description.value:
A vegetable salad that was once sold at an astounding price, believed to bring good luck and happiness to those who consumed it. Later, a chef replaced the expensive clover with regular lettuce, making it an affordable dish for the masses.

"But now, it no longer brings anyone happiness."

D&D 5e Effect

As an action, consume this item and choose the creatures in your Main Party who can see you. The benefit begins when the next combat starts and lasts for 1 minute. For each affected creature, Crit Ratio increases by 1. A creature can benefit from only one synthesized pre-combat consumable at a time; a new one replaces the previous one.

GM Description — Original HSR Effect

Upon use, increases all allies' CRIT Rate by 18% for the next battle.
